title: Estimate, reserve, execute, settle or release, and audit Co-Unit usage
accessibility: Quote, balance, caps, and confirmation are understandable without color alone
Budget approval and cancellation are keyboard and screen-reader operable
Automated critical and serious accessibility violations equal zero
securityInvariants: Client and reviewer collaboration never consumes creator credits
No operation exceeds the confirmed maximum or bypasses entitlement
No product request directly creates payment activity
persistence: Reservation and settlement survive retries and process restart
Receipt preserves rate version, native measures, funding source, and outcome
concurrency: Parallel reservations serialize against tenant and project caps
A duplicate operation commits customer usage at most once
degradedDependencies: Provider and Stripe outage do not lose internal usage authority
Safety rejection, failure, unusable output, cache hit, and retry release or avoid debit
rollback: Rollback preserves settled receipts and releases abandoned reservations
Rate rollback cannot reinterpret an existing quote or receipt
